propositions: Plan review must independently classify every acceptance criterion as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with specific evidence for each classification, to prevent externally-verifiable criteria from passing without the required [operator-attested] tag.

Criteria missing the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag but requiring external verification must produce a finding that names the correct syntax; untagged internal criteria are implicitly codebase-verifiable per ADR 0043.

Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying the [operator-attested] tag must be rejected with evidence that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged criteria passing the same verification are accepted.
Criteria combining repository proof and external-world proof must be flagged as mixed-evidence and require splitting rather than silent assignment to one evidence kind.

High-confidence misclassification findings must participate in blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory; the frozen corpus evaluation must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives and 100% recall on named fixtures.
